CATEGORIES.TITLE: Canned response categories
CATEGORIES.HINT: Group your responses. An agent searches only one category with @buscar_predefinidas(CATEGORY).
CATEGORIES.INVALID_NAME: No parentheses and no leading «!»: the name is written in @buscar_predefinidas(…).
CATEGORIES.DELETE_HINT: Its responses are not deleted: they are left without a category.
CATEGORIES.SUGGESTED_HINT: Responses that already start the same way. Create it and they get assigned; nothing else changes.
